content:
lena: Quick flag — customer reported different retry behavior between REST and Go SDK when using an idempotency header. REST preserves X-Request-Id across retries; Go SDK drops it.

yusuf: can you paste a tiny repro?

lena: curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-Id: r-42" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

lena: Go SDK call uses client.Post(ctx, path, body, opts) where opts.Headers contains X-Request-Id but server logs show no header. Retries then create duplicate side-effects.

maria: IIRC the Go SDK normalizes headers and rejects unknown ones to avoid header smuggling. That was intentional but we've had multiple customer requests for idempotency/tracing headers.

yusuf: two things: 1) make header forwarding opt-in via config flag? 2) or better, allow passthrough for any user-provided header except internal blacklist (x-internal-*, x-forwarded-for).

lena: prefer opt-out for dev experience; customers expect passthrough from SDK. Also need test asserting header preserved across retry attempts.

maria: will draft a small patch that: (a) adds CrossHeaderPassthrough bool in client config default true, (b) maintains blacklist, (c) adds e2e that proxies and echoes headers, asserts X-Request-Id present on retry.

maria: also noticed mismatch in param names: REST accepts `conversation_id` but Go SDK used `thread_id` in earlier version. We should accept both for backward compat.

yusuf: add a compatibility layer that maps thread_id -> conversation_id and warn in logs for deprecation.

lena: docs ask users to follow quickstart curl examples — we should update quickstart to show SDK parity example for idempotency header. Otherwise onboarding will keep generating support tickets.

docs-bot: docs suggestion: add note to "SDK parity" section and a one-line code snippet showing header passthrough.

maria: opening issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/issues/221 — will include tests + changelog note. Target patch release 0.9.4.

yusuf: LGTM. ping me on the PR for review.

lena: thanks, team — blocking customer reduced.

docs-bot: changelog entry queued for 0.9.4: "SDK: preserve user headers across retries; accept conversation_id|thread_id"
